description: An MCP bridge exposing UCI chess engines such as Stockfish or Leela Chess Zero to any MCP client
rules: The engine is not bundled: install a UCI engine separately and pass its path as the first argument -- uvx chess-uci-mcp@latest /usr/local/bin/stockfish
Any UCI-compatible engine works, not only Stockfish; Leela Chess Zero (lc0) is covered by the test suite
Six tools are served: analyze, get_best_move, set_position, engine_info, get_engine_options, set_engine_options
Startup UCI options use a repeatable flag taking two values: -o Threads 4 -o Hash 128
Options can also be read and changed while the server runs, with get_engine_options and set_engine_options
analyze always requires an explicit FEN; set_position stores a position for the next get_best_move only
analyze reports the score from White's perspective: a float in pawns, or the string mateN for a forced mate
Thinking time defaults to 1000 ms; override it per call with time_ms, or for the whole server with --think-time
